review:
AFK Airport Security is a 5x3 Nolimit City slot built around a feature meter above the reels. Each spin can fill it with modifiers that play out on the grid: Quarantine removes one or two low symbols, Full Body Scanner upgrades a low symbol to a premium, Not My Bag drops three to six matching mystery symbols, and Arm Slides expands every wild into a full reel.

xZone and xSplit add further ways to grow or split the reels. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a max win of 19,693x. It's a satirical take on airport queues that plays like a modifier lottery on every spin.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
